# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 31
- **Additions**: +4095
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T12:44:05Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/context.dart';
```

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the `blob:sha256:<hash>` reference is interpolated into a path with no validation of `hash` — path traversal**

```dart
final hash = blobRef.startsWith('blob:sha256:')
    ? blobRef.substring('blob:sha256:'.length)
    : null;
...
final blobPath = '$homeDir/.omp/agent/blobs/$hash';
```

A crafted (or corrupted) session line containing e.g. `blob:sha256:../../.fah/config` makes the importer `fileInfo`/`readBinaryFile` on `$homeDir/.omp/agent/blobs/../../.fah/config` — arbitrary file reads within the process's permissions. The downstream base64-shape check (`_base64Payload`) does bound what gets *embedded* as an image, but the read itself happens and file metadata leaks; multi-line base64-ish files also pass that check.

The blob dir is content-addressed, so the hash should be validated before use:

```dart
if (hash == null || !RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$').hasMatch(hash)) {
  return ForeignImage.skipped('malformed blob ref: $blobRef');
}
```

(ideally hex-only, matching sha256). Low real-world risk — the foreign store is the user's own — but the PR claims security invariants, so this should be closed.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: claude `tool_result` blocks are imported AND counted as skipped — `skippedBlocks` is wrong for every claude session**

The adapter correctly lifts each `tool_result` block into its own `toolResult` `ForeignMessage` (lines 139–153). But it then parses the parent message's content again via `parseForeignContent(message['content'], ...)`, and `parseForeignContent` (foreign_session.dart) counts every `tool_result` block it sees as a skip:

```dart
if (item['type'] == 'tool_result') {
  onSkip();        // ← counted as a dropped block...
  continue;
}
```

So every imported tool result is also reported as a dropped block — the runner prints `skipped-blocks N` where N includes content that actually survived. Fix: filter `tool_result` blocks out before calling `parseForeignContent` for the parent user message in this adapter (or pass a flag so the lift site and the parse site share one decision), keeping the skip count honest.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):

💡 **SUGGESTION: `var skippedRecords` is never reassigned — use `final`**

```dart
var skippedRecords = parse.skippedRecords;
```

The variable is returned unchanged at the end of `mapForeignSession`. `final` (or inlining it into the `MappedImport` constructor) removes the false impression that the mapper drops additional whole records.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):

💡 **SUGGESTION: the non-ranged fallback of `_readPrefix` reads the whole file with no size gate**

The ranged path bounds the header read to 4096 bytes and `scanForeignLines` enforces `maxFileBytes` before reading — but when `fs` is not a `RangedReadFileSystem` (e.g. `MemoryExecutionEnv`, the web shell), `fs.readTextFile(path)` pulls the **entire** file into memory during discovery, unbounded by `ImportLimits`. `LocalExecutionEnv` is ranged so the real CLI is unaffected, but the fallback should still consult `fileInfo(...).size` against `limits.maxFileBytes` (or stream lines and stop after the header) so the 512 MiB cap story holds on every backend.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):

💡 **SUGGESTION: `summary` is shadowed here — the pattern variable hides the `_importOne` parameter**

```dart
case PlannedCompaction(:final summary):
  await session.appendCompaction(
    summary: summary,
    ...
```

The `:final summary` pattern field shadows the enclosing `summary` parameter (`ForeignSessionSummary`) for the rest of the switch arm. It compiles (the PR calls this out), but a reader can no longer tell which `summary` an unqualified reference means — and a later edit that reaches for the outer `summary` inside this arm silently binds the wrong value. Rename one of them (e.g. `case PlannedCompaction(:final summary) => appendCompaction(summary: compactionSummary, ...)` via a local alias).

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):

💡 **SUGGESTION: silent no-op when the repo isn't a `JsonlSessionRepo`**

```dart
final repo = _repo;
if (adapter == null || repo is! JsonlSessionRepo) return;
```

After the user picked a harness and a session, this returns without a line when the session repo is a different implementation — the TUI just sits there. `_importHarness` is set, so the flow looks alive but step 3 is a dead end. Emit one line (`import: this session store does not support import`) so the failure is observable; alternatively gate step 2 (open the session picker) on the repo type so the user never reaches an impossible step 3.

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. The parser rejects line 29 and everything after it cascades (the analyzer reports 36 errors in this file: `Expected to find ';'`, `The name 'get' is already defined`, `missing_function_parameters`, then type fallout like `ompRoot` resolving to `String Function()`).

```

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. ## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

Closes #1562.

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).

- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). # pr-1563: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)

## Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. - **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 31
- **Additions**: +4095
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T12:44:05Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).

- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). - omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.

- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).

- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). **TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. - omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.

- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 31
- **Additions**: +4095
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T12:44:05Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. - **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 31
- **Additions**: +4095
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T12:44:05Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. - **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: in headless mode `io.writeln` writes to stderr — AC11's "stdout carries ids/counts only" is inverted at the bin boundary**

`_TerminalCliIO` (bin/fah_io.dart) implements the repo's CliIO contract: `write` is the primary stream (stdout), `writeln` is the diagnostics stream — and in headless mode it is wired to **stderr**:

```dart
void writeln(String text) =>
    headless ? stderr.writeln(text) : stdout.writeln(text);
```

`_runImportCommand` constructs `_TerminalCliIO(headless: true)` and passes `onLine: io.writeln`, so every `imported <id> → <faId> (n records)` / `skipped ...` line — the command's only product — lands on stderr and stdout stays empty. Scripts doing `fa import --all` and reading stdout get nothing.

The IT test titled "AC11: stdout carries ids/counts only" only inspects the runner's `lines` list via the `onLine` callback, so it cannot catch the bin wiring. Fix here:

```dart
onLine: (line) => io.write('$line\n'),
```

(or `stdout.writeln` directly, matching how the trajectory command emits).

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step.
